turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’m 56, and over the past year my shortness of breath has been steadily getting worse, and I’ve also lost weight. I worked construction and later in a steel mill, and I’m still an active smoker. I haven’t had fevers, cough, or chest pain.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of what you're experiencing, have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as blurriness, blind spots, or any loss of sight?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my vision—no blurriness, blind spots, or loss of sight. My main issue has been the steadily worsening shortness of breath, along with the weight loss.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had nausea or any stomach upset. I mainly just notice the worsening shortness of breath and the weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and there’s no pain—my symptoms have mostly been the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling emotionally. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or feeling under a lot of pressure?
turns.patient_answer: “I wouldn’t say I’ve had significant stress or been under unusual pressure. It’s mainly been the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your symptoms, have you noticed if your urine has been darker than usual lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed my urine getting darker than usual. My main symptoms have been the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the weight loss.

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, could you tell me if you have noticed this mass growing or changing in size rapidly over a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast mass at all, so there’s nothing that’s been growing or changing rapidly. My symptoms have stayed focused on the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what might be going on, could you tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain in my wrist. My only main problems have been the steadily worsening shortness of breath and the weight loss.”
